latest.notes: The log being rewritten while on air is now recorded in Settings > Diagnostics on its own — no stall needed. A queue that simply advanced is told apart from one that was rewritten (a queued row deleted without airing, a row inserted ahead of what was queued, or the order changed), and every automatic writer — regeneration, auto-fill, the safety net, the top-of-hour trim, a traffic rebuild, a skipped segment — now signs its work, so the report names what changed the log instead of leaving it open.
